narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guides for stable double-digit revenue growth around 10% to 12%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Sales figures show strong annual scaling with March ending quarters hitting 13700.0 and 13942.0.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management claims margins will hover around specific bands like 30-31% or historically lower 18-19%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Actual OPM % exhibits extreme seasonality with massive spikes in Q4 up to 39% and lower figures in other quarters.

promises.credibility: Management generally delivers on headline revenue growth targets, but operating margins display high seasonal volatility that deviates from steady-state margin guidance.

bull: ROCE is strong at 32.0% and ROE is robust at 24.0%.
Latest quarter Jun 2026 revenue grew 14% YoY with EBITDA up 19%.
5-year free cash flow is ₹42,534 Cr and was negative in 0 of 5 years.
bear: Working capital is stretching significantly as the cash conversion cycle worsened from 484 to 788 days.
Capex in progress with CWIP at 45% of fixed assets means growth capacity is not yet earning.
Operating EBITDA margin guidance of 30% to 31% was only partly met as margins fluctuated between quarters.
